title: 0% Finance for 3 Years
shortDescription: Drive away in a new MHERO with zero interest financing across a 36-month term.
description: For a limited time, take delivery of any MHERO model with 0% interest financing over 36 months. Enjoy fixed monthly payments with no hidden fees, arranged through our approved finance partners.
terms: Offer valid on new MHERO I and Model 2 purchases only.
Subject to credit approval by participating finance partners.
Cannot be combined with other financing promotions.
Offer valid while stocks last and may be withdrawn at any time.

title: 3 Years Complimentary Service
shortDescription: Enjoy scheduled maintenance on us for the first three years of ownership.
description: Every new MHERO purchased this quarter comes with a complimentary 3-year scheduled maintenance package, covering all manufacturer-recommended service intervals at authorized MHERO service centers.
terms: Applies to scheduled maintenance only; excludes wear-and-tear parts.
Valid at authorized MHERO service centers only.
Must be redeemed within the 3-year period from delivery date.

title: AED 15,000 Trade-In Bonus
shortDescription: Get an extra AED 15,000 towards your new MHERO when you trade in your current vehicle.
description: Trade in any vehicle, regardless of make or model, and receive an additional AED 15,000 bonus on top of the market valuation towards the purchase of a new MHERO.
terms: Trade-in vehicle must be owned by the purchaser for a minimum of 6 months.
Final valuation subject to physical inspection at an MHERO showroom.
Bonus applied as a deduction on the new vehicle invoice only.
Not valid in conjunction with the 0% finance offer.
